title: The Cultivated Practices of Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual evaluation discussing the over-representation of Western viewpoints and ways of seeing encoded in Web-scraped training datasets.
Review of dataset composition statistics, specifically evaluating the disproportionate over-representation of the English language in the LAION-5B dataset compared to other languages.
Literature review of prior dataset audits (e.g., citing Birhane et al.) to highlight the presence of malign stereotypes, racist slurs, and ethnic slurs in training data.
